_comment: Ratchet baseline for the fail-closed WS payload validation (audit F-19, wave 1 / R3). `node scripts/audit/command-inventory.mjs --check` fails when schema coverage drops below `withSchema`, when either exemption list grows, or when a registered command is left uncovered.
